title: Static function named `reset_state` (and others) are quietly ignored
body: ### Tested versions Reproducible in: 4.6.2.stable ### System information Godot v4.6.2.stable - Linux Mint 22.3 (Zena) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 (nvidia; 570.211.01) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-4790K CPU @ 4.00GHz (8 threads) - 15.48 GiB memory ### Issue description Static function with the name `reset_state` is ignored at runtime. There is no error, no warning, breakpoint within the function doesn't trigger, code within the function doesn't execute. ```gdscript class_name Main extends Node2D func _ready() -> void: print("started") Main.reset_state() print("finished") static func reset_state() -> void: print("called: reset_state") ``` Expected behavior: The function should execute normally or it should throw an error. ### Steps to reproduce Create a static function with the name `reset_state` and try to use it. Code within the function will be ignored. As far as I can tell it is connected to the GDScript class. Method `reset_state` is defined within Resource class which is base class of GDScript. Other methods from Resource and GDScript are ignored as well. If the original method has parameters and the static version does not, then it fails at runtime. For example: ```gdscript class_name Main extends Node2D func _ready() -> void: print("started") Main.get_id_for_path() print("finished") static func get_id_for_path() -> void: print("called: get_id_for_path") ``` Produces runtime error: ``` Invalid call to function 'get_id_for_path' in base 'GDScript'. Expected 1 argument(s). ``` ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [function_call_issue.tar.gz](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27396542/function_call_issue.tar.gz)
